citations.claim: first violation: controller force exceeds fmax
controller_force at violating step is 101.72 > 42.954 fmax
previous step force was correctly capped at fmax, showing clamp intermittently fails

counterfactual.change: Increased controller fmax from 42.954 to 110 (single field change, same steps/dt/kp/vcmd/waypoint). Computed force 101.72 is now below limit, violation disappears, confirming cause is missing force clamp.

explanation: Controller force clamping fails at step 406. With kp=27.62, vcmd=11.46 and fmax=42.95, the controller commands 101.72 N (≈2.37× limit). Steps 400-405 show force correctly capped at 42.954, but at 406 the computed kp*velocity-error exceeds fmax and is not clamped. Raising fmax above the computed value removes the violation, proving limit enforcement is missing/faulty rather than a dynamics edge case.
vision_note: Across steps 403-406 the red controller-driven body hovers almost motionless just to the right of the green waypoint cross with negligible frame-to-frame displacement. Step 406, the first reported violation, is visually identical to 403-405 with no jump, wall penetration, out-of-bounds motion or tunneling visible.
